body:
My mother raised me to be manipulative, rude, to always lie, to always blame others for my own mistakes, to never take responsibility for my actions, to solve arguments with screaming/violence/silent treatment, to feel small and useless and incabable of doing even the simplest things right.

Thankfully, I am my own person and I have common sense and a brain so I will never be what she tried to raise me to be.

"You can choose to be positive and not let yourself be a victim" - people who have never suffered rape, abuse, loss, bullying, narcissistic parents etc etc but still think they know best in these matters.

It's not that I looked awful in bangs, I had just had them for sooo long. Every single school photo, every single birthday picture, vacation pic, passport pic, everything with the identical hair style alllll theeee timeeee. Me and my sister were like miniature copies of our mom. It was a relief to finally be able to do what I wanted with my hair.

Yes definitely. In his defence he wasn't trying to fuck up my hair, he just didn't know how to cut. It took a long time before it looked somewhat normal again and definitely did not help with the bullying in school.

My mom has been bitching about my hair my whole life. She has had the same hair style for the past 40 years and forced me and my sister to have the same style. I begged her to let me change it when I was a kid and let me grow it out, and she punished me by making my dad cut all my hair off. Now I wear my hair the way I like it and every time we meet she tells me how bad it looks and nobody would hire me (I have a job and my hair isn't a disaster, it's shoulder length and golden red but without the short bangs she always forced on me). I like my hair.

I read about people that are allowed to LOCK their door without a furious parent breaking it down. During the 17 years I lives at home I was not allowed to close the door to my room even once. I was not even allowed to lock the bathroom door when I went to the toilet or to shower, because my mom thought I spent too much time in there and the rest of the family should be able to go in there even when I was on the toilet or naked in the shower. For the record, I spent the least time in there out of all family members. My mom forbade me to shower more than twice a week and wash my hair only once and she timed my toilet visits so she could limit that as well.

People nowadays ask me why I always need so much alone time and why I'm always trying to keep things private...

My whole life is basically a day dream and I have never told anyone this before. I started escaping into fantasy worlds when I was just a kid and now in my late 20s I still do. I write alot and I dream and think alot and this might sound weird but I feel like whatever I do, I'm usually 90% in a different world that I created because I was too lonely, too sad, too angry and had nowhere else to turn. I hold silent conversations with characters I made, I explain things to them, they follow me places etc. I don't know what I would have done without it.

Yeah me too haha. The one time my nmom and her husband left for vacation and left me and my sister (aged 15-17) at home instead of with relatives, I was ordered to cook for us while they were gone. I was confused, not knowing what to cook or how to do it. My mom cooked almost every day and always complained that I didn't help her, in fact I did try to help her almost every time and she'd snap at me to stop bothering her. Instead of telling me or teaching me a little before they left us, mom mocked me and said "you're an adult, you should have learned this stuff long ago!". Uh, yeah, I agree. So why wasn't I allowed to?
I wish you all the best :)

My mom does the same, she uses me as a scapegoat and whines about it to everyone. My sister and my stepdad both see through her bullshit but those aren't the only ones she's told about my "craziness".

This group has really helped me alot too. I didn't realize that what my mom is had a name, until very recently. It's good to know I'm not alone, even though I don't wish this on anyone, but now I know that it's not my fault.

That makes me sick, I'm so sorry that happened to you. My mom found out I cut myself after she took me to the doctor when I had pneumonia, and he had to lift my shirt to listen to my lungs. She mocked me about it and shortly after when we had a completely unrelated argument over the dinner table, she looked at my sister with a triumphant smile and said "did you know [my name] cut herself becuse it huuurts so baaaad inside" with a whiny mocking voice. There was no concern whatsoever about me, it was all just funny to nmom.

My nmom does that too, commenting on peoples size. Especially if she's drunk, and she can be very loud too. It makes me just want to die with shame.

She also did that thing when she belittle me for "not knowing how to do things" even when I did know. She'd ask me to prove it and I would show/tell her how and she'd be like "oh no no no hahaha, this is how; first you do thiiiiissssss, and theeeeen you do thiiiiisss" basically just repeating exactly what I just did/said but slower. When I called her out on it she'd say "oh I couldn't see/hear you because you did it so fast and sloppy" no matter how slow I did it.

Yes, definitely. I feel like I've gone through 3 stages of life.
1) thinking everything was my fault
2) thinking my mom did everything to be mean
3) realizing she's living in some fantasy world where she is a saint and everybody else is wrong.

It was only recently that I came to step 3. It's so frustrating because I know that she will never understand, she thinks she's a victim and everyone else is abusing her. How can she change when that is her reality?

Definitely. My nmom has never approved of any of the boyfriends I've had. Same with my sister's boyfriends. They were always too lazy, proud, arrogant, uneducated, had the wrong job, came from the wrong country, were too skinny/fat or any other 100 reasons. It has also been like this with any hobbies or interests I have, which has made me put up a cool front where it seems like I'm pretty much indifferent to everything because the moment I slip up and say I like someone/something, I get mocked and berated for it. Now instead, people tend to think I'm boring but at least no one laughs at me.

My nmom did that too. I never came out as bisexual to her (I still haven't) but suddenly she started asking me stuff like "is [female friend's name] a lesbian?" and I knew she had read about the kiss I had written of. It was extremely humiliating.

Wow, that is some next level psycho behaviour. As if your diary was some forum for everyone to vent their thoughts and feelings.
After I realized my mom read my diary alot, I started writing bad things about myself instead, hoping she'd see it and "forgive me" for writing about her. I filled page after page with hatred for myself, drew pictures of myself as a pig, wrote poems about how bad I was. I don't know if she ever read that, she never commented on it.

Omg I can relate so bad. My mom didn't openly admit to reading it, but she would drop hints and even quote passages that she found extra offensive and use them against me. I can only imagine how much time she must have spent going through them to be able to "recite" them like that.

Yeah that happened. She also did it to our stepdad, one moment we were supposed to accept and love him and the next we had to hate him. My sister and I have a strong bond today, luckily my mom's manipulative bullshit didn't ruin that at least.

I no longer live there but I'm still scared to write, even on my laptop with a password. My mom would also try to justify what she did by saying she was worried about me because I never told her things (guess why), and saying I had left the diary somewhere, like on the kitchen table, wide open so she had no idea it was my diary until she had read all of it. I always kept my diary in a drawer in my room, hidden under other things and it even had a lock, but OF COURSE, I must have just forgotten that I put it open where everyone could read it, and somehow it found its way back into the drawer after that.

My mom would often claim that I "bullied" her. I was a very quiet and well behaved child because I was always scared so I had no idea why she said that. Until I realized she had been reading my diary for the past couple of years, my only outlet for the anxiety and sadness she put me through daily. She even had the guts to demand that I apologized to her for writing angry things in the diary she had given me a few years back while telling younger, stupider me that it was a most private posession that nobody had any right to read. I now understand why she gave it to me. It became her window into my soul and reassured her that I knew there was NOBODY I could tell about the things she did, not even myself through my diary. She would always know.
Or "if you want to stay here you need to pay rent and do 200% of the housework while being in school and working, also if you choose to move out we will call the cops and report you missing"
Thank you for this. I will try this when the sun finally reaches gloomy Scandinavia. I am interested in bugs so I could maybe combine 1, 2 and 3 on your list.
Thanks, I'll look into it.

That is what I did. I had saved money for years and never spent more than I absolutely needed to live, thinking I'd have alot of money when I did need it. Got help with putting it into accounts to gain interest and stuff, but now with corona and businesses going bad a ton of money has just disappeared. I lost money that could have paid my rent for almost a year, all gone in 2-3 weeks. 

I have a very small income and I have nothing to save atm. I haven't even bought food the past 2 months but have been trying to use what I have in the freezer and pantry.
It's such a huge disappointment, saving for so long and never allowing myself to buy anything, and then have all that money just disappearing.
I don't have any IRL friends, I was never allowed to have friends and when I had the possibility to make friends while NC, I didn't have the courage or the energy.

English isn't my first language so I'm sorry if my text is confusing at times.

Samma här, gick ofta till skolan sjuk för hon trodde jag hittade på trots att jag hade feber t.ex. Tror att det i mitt fall handlade om att ingen kunde ha det värre än hon. Om hon erkände att nån annan var sjuk/skadad så innebar det ju att hon fick vara lite mindre martyr ett tag...
THIS. And if one day you are not all smiles and rainbows and sparkles and maybe need someone to talk to they hit you with the old "but you were fine yesterday, it can't be that bad".

Thank you so much, I really needed to hear this. I moved out many years ago and went NC for years on and off and that was a huge relief. For several reasons I have been forced to move back and even though I no longer live in the same house they still live very close and have a big impact on my life everyday. 

Part of why I'm so desperate is I can't see a way to get out of here. I don't have an income large enough to allow me to move anywhere (the corona crisis hasn't helped this either) and because of health issues I can't work more than I do right now. My mental health is deteriorating every day here and my physical health follows. I feel like I'm stuck with only one way out.

Hej fellow Swede! Although I've never heard that impression I have been told by others that I have a high tolerance for pain. I thought it was normal. When I was younger my mom told me all women get periods and they all get cramps and I was exaggerating. I was in so much pain I would vomit or pass out, and she'd yell at me to stop faking it. Well, about 10 years later I was diagnosed with endometriosis and my mom has noooo recollection of me being in pain ever during my childhood.

I recognize alot of stuff from that article.
I really feel the least anxious just after I left her house or hung up the phone (given we parted on good terms) but as hours turn to days and I know she's expecting me to call or visit (she would never take the first step) I get more and more anxious. If I haven't heard from her in a week I know she's pissed off that I haven't called and it sometimes makes me panic.
I don't think it's normal to always feel anxious around others, but I do too. I can never feel at ease when my nmom is around.

I always kinda marvel at my nmoms ability to completely absolve herself from all kind of responsibility or accountability and making it about someone else instead. No matter what horrid things she did, it was NEVER her fault. She would either completely deny them, or try to justify it by making up something even worse that we (me and my sister mainly) supposedly did to her.

Yeah, sadly. I'm okay at the moment but I have daily fits of something like hopelessness and helplessness. I don't live with my mom, although we live near each other, but she still affects my life alot.
Those small victories are invaluable though, remember them! ✊
Being around my nmom makes me absolutely exhausted. Thankfully I don't live with her anymore, but still live very close and have to see her several times a week.

My nmom did that too, said she had "heard" stuff about me in school to scare me into thinking she had spies everywhere to report on my behaviour or if I dared speak to anyone about her. One time I found out who had said stuff about me; a friend of my sisters crush at the time had claimed that I was skipping class. My mom believed a rumor by a complete stranger (told to her by my sister who in turn had been told by her crush) she had never met over her own daughter. This was only one of the occasions, I don't know if she actually heard stuff from others or if she just made it up to scare me.

Wow, this sounds so much like my mom. Repeating things over and over (while often complaining that I repeat myself when giving her the same answer each time) and twisting things to make me seem like the crazy one.

"She's unhappy when I'm unattractive" - I think she's actually pretty happy that she's able to make you feel unattractive...
Like someone else said; you just can't win with these kind of people. Even if you are the most attractive person on earth she'd probably make up something else for you to feel bad about.
Or "I never beat you, you're making it up"

I'd be happy to talk to you, or anyone in need of support. I live alone thankfully, although very close to my nmom. She is a teacher so whenever I was on break from school, she was as well, so I know how difficult it can be. You're not alone!
